parsed.explanation: If outed, a visitor faces tier-1 universal exposures: a state facility ban in schools/state-owned buildings backed by documented trespass arrest and men's-ward holding, federal binary passport policy, and entry screening directing refusal on sex-document discrepancy with possible permanent fraud ineligibility. National custody reports of hormone removal, forced labour and sexual abuse raise severity if detained. Mitigations are real but partial: private facilities are not covered by this state's law, there is no presentation offence or organised police extortion/sweeps, federal hate-crime/employment protections exist, and courts have enjoined some measures and are hearing passport challenges. No state anti-discrimination or hate-crime cover, hostile state threat-framing, and unremedied facility/document rules keep this well below reduced-risk, but functioning courts and narrow private-sector scope keep it above sustained targeting at 0.35.
